notes.1v.2a: Loftunga is the poet Thorarin loftunga. 'The lair that Fafnir owned' is gold, on which the dragon lay. The verse continues past the unit.

nodes.text: this verse: To Loftunga you long gave the lair that Fafnir owned; you let me, O
